title: Elspeth Catherine Barter
dates: (11 Feb 1843- 27 March 1938)
---

daughter of the Rt. Rev. George Moberly

She married (10 Sept 1863) the Rev. Henry Barter (1835/6-1901), from 1868 Vicar of Shipton-under-Wychwood. Referred to as Kitty Barter, she is not to be confused with Kate Barter, her sister-in-law, or with her husband’s cousin Katharine Mary (Barter) Wordsworth (d.1897). [Dulce Domum]
